It seems you have not yet found any humans willing to help you.{wait}{clear}When you guide people in the right direction, they will surely become heroes.{wait}{clear}Work together with the fairies in your duties, so that you may also uncover the cause of Arcaya's chaos.

It seems there are humans willing to help you.{wait}{clear}While they are still inexperienced, it is best to act together with them as much as you can. Sending a fairy along with them is also a good idea.
＄＄＄＄＄＄, are you coming to understand the people of Arcaya little by little?{wait}{clear}Opening their hearts takes time. Do not rush; keep going to see them.
＄＄＄＄＄＄, be sure to watch Arcaya's chaos level.{wait}{clear}The chaos level is tied to the enemies' strength, so you must be careful when you ask a hero to take on a mission.

How are things in Arcaya?{wait}{clear}I imagine all manner of chaos is breaking out, but please find its cause as quickly as you can.{wait}{clear}It is a hard duty, but I am counting on you and the heroes.
I am watching over your work from here. If you are ever troubled, come back at any time.
＄＄＄＄＄＄... I am sure you will be able to understand the heroes.{wait}{clear}When you and the heroes come to trust each other, that power will save the world.

So the Demon Stone in Arcaya is the cause of every calamity...{wait}{clear}The Demon Stone fell into the hands of the wicked, and that has brought about the present chaos.{wait}{clear}Stop those who would use the stone's power... ＄＄＄＄＄＄...
It is humans who are gathering the Demon Stone, but something seems to lie behind them...{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄, be careful.

＄＄＄＄＄＄, I think you already know, but the fallen angels will use every means to bring Arcaya to ruin.{wait}{clear}People's sorrow is a step toward the void they desire.{wait}{clear}You and the heroes may be exposed to even greater danger than now. Please, be very careful.
Only a little time remains.{wait}{clear}You are our last hope. I am counting on you... ＄＄＄＄＄＄...{wait}{clear}Save Arcaya from ruin, together with the heroes.
The duty in the world below is a hard one. But do not lose heart; keep at it.{wait}{clear}I am always watching over you.
Never forget what it means that you are an angel.{wait}{clear}Then the place you must go should become clear of itself.
May the blessings of Heaven and earth always be with you...
Oh? It seems you cannot carry any more items. A pity, but let us leave it for another time.
＄＄＄＄＄＄, here is a bonus of ＜ボーナスＡＰ＞ AP. Put it to use in your work in Arcaya.

All right, I'll go. If I go, I should be able to find something out.

All right... There, surely...{wait}{clear}I'll go. I'll get there before anyone else, no matter what...!

All right... Something that isn't human... I'll go and find out.
That highway matters. I'll go.
That's... a nasty incident... I'll find the cause as quickly as I can.
All right... I'll go. I want an incident that grim resolved right away.
A two-headed monster... All right, I'll go.
I see... All right... I'll go. I have to do something about this...
All right... I'll go...
All right, I'll go. Legrance is a young, precious country; that's exactly why we can't lose it...
All right, I'll go at once. Summoning monsters... it must be mages with ties to the Empire.{wait}{clear}I'll stop them before it's too late to undo.
Zombies... Then it's my job.{wait}{clear}I'll go.
Fine. If they've come out, I'll go.
Yeah, fine...
They've appeared even in Ecclesia... Fine... I'll go...
Fine... I'll go.
The Demon Stone... the Heavenly Dragon... Fine... I have to go...
So this day has finally come... I'll take him down myself... No matter what!
So he's finally shown himself... I can't let this chance slip... Let's go...

Slatina, you say? I'll go...

In Karnal? Someone like that inside Legrance's borders? Unforgivable...{wait}{clear}Let me go, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.

Yeah, all right... I'll go.
Yeah... So they've finally come...{wait}{clear}Legrance is my country... I'll hurry there.

Red armor... All right, I'll go!
Damn it! I won't let everything go the Empire's way!{wait}{clear}I'm going, for my brother's sake too!
All right... I'll go and do everything I can. But be ready for the worst too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
